subject: 🏃 Friday — Bodyweight Strength + PT (Wk 9)
html:
Tomorrow: Bodyweight Strength + PT — no gym needed, all BW. You're still in BC with no gym access, so this is a floor session. Dynamic warm-up first: 90/90 PAILs (30 sec each), glute bridges (10 reps, 2-sec hold), then move through the circuit: BW Bulgarian split squats (3×10 each side, 3-sec eccentric), single-leg RDL balance (3×8 each, no weight — focus on the hip hinge and anti-rotation), Spanish squat hold (3×30–45 sec, wall sit if no band), Copenhagen plank on a chair (3×30 sec/side), reverse Nordics anchored under furniture (3×10, slow descent), and single-leg calf raises (3×12 each). Finish with the full PT block — it's non-negotiable: dead bug with banded pulldown if you have a band (or unresisted slow marches, 2×10), side plank with hip abduction (top toe down, 8/side), chin tuck + lifts (2 each direction, 3-sec hold).

Focus cue: the PT block is the priority. Your last loaded strength session was June 17 — over two weeks ago. The hip ER/abductor/core rehab work is what's kept the knee at 1/5 through every run of this build. Heading into Sunday's 16-miler (the biggest run of the plan) and then the peak-volume week without that insurance is a risk. If you're short on time, cut the Bulgarians and calf raises — keep the PT exercises and Copenhagen planks.

Knee & hamstring: Knee has been 1/5 all week — clean. The right-hamstring hint from Tuesday's threshold reps resolved and hasn't returned. If any exercise tomorrow wakes either one up, stop that exercise and move on. Knee 2+ → PT and mobility only, skip all loaded patterns.

Context: Week 9, Phase 3 — Peak Volume & Power. 23 days to the SF Marathon. Tomorrow is Saturday travel home, then Sunday's 16-mi long run with 8 mi at MP is the week's centerpiece — the critical test of fueling gels at HR 150–160 effort (the Presidio fix). This BW session keeps the protective strength patterns alive without adding any fatigue into Sunday. You've earned a strong week so far (threshold reps Wed, easy run Thu); tomorrow deposits durability, not load.

Prep: Lay out a mat or towel and find a sturdy chair/couch to anchor your feet for the reverse Nordics tonight so you're not hunting for gear in the morning. Hydrate well — you fly home tomorrow.
